== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Spirit-fruits are highly potent, rare botanical items that possess significant spiritual properties. Unlike standard fruit, such as the common [[orus fruit]] found in [[Sacred Valley]], spirit-fruits are formed when a tree concentrates centuries of [[vital aura]] into its produce. This process can result in fruit that appears as flawless [[white madra]] or possesses unique, jelly-like physical textures. They are considered immense delicacies and valuable assets for [[sacred artists]], often commanding high prices due to their ability to provide massive amounts of purified [[vital aura]]. These fruits serve various roles in spiritual cultivation. Some, like the [[ancestral orus fruit]], can provide years' worth of purified aura that a user can process into [[madra]], and they have been known to assist in activating specific spiritual boundaries or clouds. Other varieties, such as the [[Starlotus Bud|Starlotus bud]], are used to facilitate rapid [[advancement]] between cultivation realms. Certain spirit-fruits, like the dawnfruit, can directly nourish a person's soul. While some believe they possess life aspects, others note their primary function is the purification of energy to aid in advancing one's [[Path]]. They are also used as ingredients in high-grade [[elixirs]] and drinks to assist with [[cycling]] or to soothe [[madra channels]].}}
